description: A Java class implementing placeholder filtering and substitution logic for authorization contexts and templates, including methods for applying, validating, and replacing placeholders with support for pipeline functions and exception handling.

classes.name: PlaceholderFilter
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for applying, validating, and replacing placeholders within templates and authorization contexts.

methods.name: applyHeadersPlaceholderToAuthContext
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in AuthorizationContext using headers, returning a new AuthorizationContext with substituted values.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overloaded method to replace placeholders in a template string using a placeholder source and a placeholder definition, or an expression resolver.

methods.name: applyOrElseDelete
methods.description: Resolves placeholders in a template, returning an Optional with the result or empty if unresolved or deleted.

methods.name: applyOrElseRetain
methods.description: Resolves placeholders in a template, returning the resolved string or the original if unresolved.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all placeholders in a template can be resolved with provided placeholders.

methods.name: validateAndReplace
methods.description: Validates and replaces all placeholders in a template with a dummy string, returning the fully replaced template.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Internal method executing placeholder resolution and handling unresolved or deleted placeholders by throwing exceptions.
